# M3-1c: Questions, users, alerts, import state

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-1c`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-1c`
- Depends on: M3-1b
- Touches (exclusive while running): store/
- Plan refs: §2 `questions`, `users`; §5 handling rules; spikes/slack.md §Recommendation; §3.7 alert budget
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
Slack questions, user identity, event de-duplication, alert history and import state all persist across restarts.

## Scope
- Migration `0008_questions.sql`. One `questions` table per §2; no `slack_questions`.
- `questions`: id, plan_id, kind (`categorize`/`dry_run_check`), subject_id, channel_id, message_ts, options (JSON: label, category_id,
  category_name), status (`pending`/`open`/`answered`/`closed`), answer, answered_by, answered_at, close_reason, created_at. Unique
  index on (channel_id, message_ts). `pending` means decided but not yet posted because of the cap.
- `users`: slack_user_id, label (`brendan`/`wife`), upserted from config. Leave OAuth subject and fun-money columns to M4/M5.
- `slack_events`: dedupe key, seen_at, with a prune older than 7 days.
- `alerts`: id, plan_id, kind, dedupe_key, critical, status (`sent`/`rolled_up`), body, created_at.
- `import_state`: plan_id, last_attempt_at, last_ok_at, last_error (redacted text).
- `alert_cursor`: plan_id, last_first_seen_at, so the anomaly rules only see new rows across restarts.
- Accessors include `ClaimAnswer`: an atomic `UPDATE ... WHERE status='open'` that reports whether this caller won.
- Reads for later tasks, which don't touch `store/`:
  - Questions: open and pending lists, by subject, and close-with-reason.
  - Alerts: `TransactionsFirstSeenAfter(ctx, planID, t)` (non-deleted, using the mirror's `first_seen_at`) and `PayeeCharges(ctx, planID, normalizedPayee, before)` for history thresholds.
  - Dry-run report: decisions in a date range, answered `dry_run_check` questions, `CountWriteLog`, and the current human-set category for a txn with when it was first seen.

## Out of scope
- Slack calls (M3-10a), alert rules (M3-12a), scheduler changes (M3-15).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: migration applies on a DB at 0007.
- [ ] Test: lookup by (channel_id, message_ts) survives reopening the DB.
- [ ] Test: of two concurrent `ClaimAnswer` calls, exactly one wins (goroutines, `-race`).
- [ ] Test: a repeated event key reports as a duplicate; prune removes only old keys.
- [ ] Test: counts of open and pending questions; import state and the alert cursor round-trip.
- [ ] Fixture tests: `TransactionsFirstSeenAfter` excludes older and deleted rows; `PayeeCharges` respects `before`; the dry-run report reads return the expected rows.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `store/migrations/0008_questions.sql`: `questions`, `users`, `slack_events`, `alerts`, `import_state`, `alert_cursor`; index
    `transactions (plan_id, first_seen_at)`. CHECKs tie status to fields (pending has no message key; open/answered need one;
    answered needs answer/by/at; closed needs a reason); unique (channel_id, message_ts); at most one live (pending/open)
    question per (plan, kind, subject); `answered_by` and `users.label` limited to `brendan`/`wife`.
  - `store/questions.go`: `InsertQuestion` (pending, or open if channel+ts given), `MarkQuestionPosted`, `ClaimAnswer`
    (single `UPDATE ... WHERE status='open'`, returns won), `CloseQuestion`, `QuestionByID/ByMessage`, `OpenQuestions`,
    `PendingQuestions`, `QuestionsBySubject`, `AnsweredQuestions(kind, from, to)`, `CountQuestions`; `UpsertUsers`,
    `UserBySlackID`; `SeenSlackEvent` (reports duplicate), `PruneSlackEvents` (>7 days).
  - `store/alerts.go`: `InsertAlert` (dedupe on plan+kind+key, reports inserted), `CountSentNonCritical` (budget),
    `Alerts(from, to)`; `RecordImport`/`GetImportState`; `SetAlertCursor`/`AlertCursor`; `TransactionsFirstSeenAfter`;
    `PayeeCharges`.
  - `store/report_read.go`: `DecisionsBetween`, `CountWriteLog`, `CurrentHumanCategory` (category, split/deleted, human
    lock, first_seen_at).
  - Tests in `store/questions_test.go`; migration counts bumped in `store/store_test.go`.
- Acceptance:
  - Migration on a 0007 DB → pass (`TestMigration0008OnExisting0007DB`)
  - (channel_id, message_ts) lookup survives reopen → pass (`TestQuestionByMessageSurvivesReopen`)
  - Concurrent ClaimAnswer, exactly one wins, 20 rounds → pass (`go test -race ./store -run TestConcurrentClaimAnswer`)
  - Event dedupe + prune only old keys → pass (`TestSlackEventDedupeAndPrune`)
  - Open/pending counts, import state, alert cursor round-trip → pass (`TestCountsListsAndCloseQuestions`,
    `TestImportStateRoundTrip`, `TestAlertCursorRoundTrip`)
  - Fixtures: `TestTransactionsFirstSeenAfter`, `TestPayeeCharges`, `TestDryRunReportReads`, `TestAnsweredQuestionsInRange` → pass
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → green; `go test -race ./store` → green
- Deviations from brief:
  - `answered_by` stores the user label (`brendan`/`wife`), not the Slack id, to match `write_log.actor`; callers resolve
    via `UserBySlackID` first, and an unknown Slack user can't answer.
  - `PayeeCharges(ctx, planID, normalizedPayee, before string)`: `before` is a `YYYY-MM-DD` date (exclusive) on
    `transactions.date`; returns only live, non-transfer outflows (amount < 0). Payee match is `NormalizePayee` of the payee
    name, else the imported name, done in Go over the plan's outflows (fine at household scale).
  - Added beyond the list: unique live-question index per (plan, kind, subject), `CountSentNonCritical` and `Alerts` for the
    alert budget and monthly roll-up, and an index on `transactions.first_seen_at`.
- Follow-ups for backlog: `PruneSlackEvents` needs a caller (M3-15 scheduler). Alerts have no "reported in monthly report"
  marker yet; the report reads by date range.
- Docs follow-ups: CLAUDE.md `store/` bullet: add `0006_decisions`, `0007_write_log_locks`, `0008_questions` to the migration
  list and mention questions/users/slack_events/alerts/import_state/alert_cursor; architecture.md §2 `questions` gained
  `plan_id`, `close_reason`, `created_at` and the `pending` status.

## Review response (agy r1)
1. [high] `CurrentHumanCategory` — fixed (`store/report_read.go`). It is now one query that joins `human_locks` and `categories`.
   New fields: `HumanSet`, `Approved`, `LockedAt` (the category lock's `created_at`) and `SeenAt` (`LockedAt` if locked,
   else `first_seen_at`). M3-16 should compare `SeenAt` to the decision time. An unlocked label falls back to
   `first_seen_at`, which comes before any decision on that row, so it never judges one; that's the conservative choice.
   A row is human-set only if it's approved or locked, and it's either a split or has a non-internal category. Otherwise
   `CategoryID` and `CategoryName` are nil: this covers YNAB's payee-memory guess on unapproved rows, Uncategorized, Ready
   to Assign and no category. Tests: `TestDryRunReportReads` (lock time wins over `first_seen_at`; unlocked falls back) and
   `TestCurrentHumanCategoryExcludesGuessesAndInternal` (an unapproved guess, internal categories and no category aren't
   human-set; a locked unapproved row is, as of its lock; a split is, with no single category).
2. [med] Alert retry and re-arm — fixed (`store/alerts.go`). I added `HasAlert(ctx, planID, kind, dedupeKey)` and
   `DeleteAlert(ctx, planID, kind, dedupeKey) (removed bool, err)`. M3-12a can call `HasAlert`, post, then `InsertAlert`
   (a failed post stores nothing, so it retries). It can also `DeleteAlert` when a link error or stale-import episode
   clears. Test: `TestHasAndDeleteAlert`.
3. [low] `PayeeCharge.ImportID` — fixed. `PayeeCharges` now selects `t.import_id`, and `TestPayeeCharges` checks it.

Checks: `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` green; `go test -race ./store` green.
